title: Motion Sickness
paragraphs: Two hours later.
“Man, it was hard to see at times since it’s night, but the moonlight actually makes things pretty visible.”
“Gua!”
Father returned in high spirits. I rushed over to greet him.
“Welcome back! How did it go?”
“Hmm… Well, Sakura-chan took down the monsters along the way while I was riding, and I ended up gaining ten levels.”
“That’s great progress.”
“I’d love to do this during the daytime. You know… to enjoy the different landscapes.”
“Hmm… I was a little worried, but it seems everything went fine.”
Éclair let out a relieved sigh.

Hah! Don’t lump me together with the Filolials. A noble Filolial wouldn’t just go running off to dangerous places. They have mastered the fusion of instinct and intelligence, achieving the perfect form of hunting.
“Anyway, Iwatani-dono.”
“What’s up? Did something happen to Ren or Itsuki?”
“No, not that. It’s about the bathhouse… The demi-humans were so hostile toward us that we couldn’t use it.”
“Ah… Yeah, I figured that might happen.”

Now that I think about it, we barely stayed in Siltvelt during the previous loop. And in the loop before that, we came as the Shield Hero, so we weren’t involved in Siltvelt’s darker side. At most, we stayed here briefly during the revolution in Melromarc to pass the time. Maybe the fact that the heroes were secretly residing here got leaked, or perhaps Melromarc’s actions and Father’s feats improved the treatment of humans. Either way, we were able to use the bathhouse back then.
“It’s not like there aren’t bathhouses for humans, but they were clearly exploiting the situation, and the area seemed unsafe. I wouldn’t recommend it.”
“Then what should we do? I mean, it’s been three days since we last bathed, and that’s pushing it.”
“We may have to settle for wiping ourselves down with water and cloth like I do.”
“I’ll heat up some water with magic. Besides, carving out a rock to make a bath is easy enough.”
“Ah, so that’s why you were preparing things after we got turned away from the bathhouse.”
“Indeed. Everything is ready! We’ll set it up by the riverside, and we’ll even have a barbecue while we’re at it.”
“Whoa… That actually sounds kinda fun.”
“Of course, I’ll leave the grilling and cooking to Father.”
“Huh? I’m the one doing it?”
Father tilted his head in confusion.
Did I say something strange?
“What about you, Motoyasu-kun?”
“Your cooking skills far surpass mine, Father.”
“Is this another one of Kitamura-dono’s ‘loop’ experiences?”
“Indeed! No matter how much I try, I couldn’t match Father’s cooking skills, even when he had just arrived in this world.”
“Huh…”
Éclair stared at him, making Father look a bit embarrassed. Then, he spoke humbly.
“Well, I wouldn’t say I’m that good at cooking…”
“Gua!”
Sakura-chan is drooling too. This is exciting. After all, anyone who has eaten Father’s cooking unanimously says it’s delicious. Even Ren and Itsuki never missed a meal back in the village.
“Well… Since some of the ingredients you brought seem edible, I guess I’ll give it a try?”
“Don’t worry, I’ll inspect everything to make sure nothing is poisonous.”
Father and the others haven’t acquired appraisal skills yet. That’s why I’ve already removed anything toxic beforehand.
Well… there are some ingredients where the poison can be neutralized through processing, but that’s something to deal with later.
“Alright then, let’s start with the prep work.”
“Yes, indeed!”
We moved to the riverside and began preparing the meal.
“Is it safe to drink the river water directly?”
“Well water would be the best option. Even with my magic, I can’t filter it completely.”
This sort of thing falls under water or earth magic, so it would be better suited for Ren or Itsuki. The best I can do is purify it with heat.
“Well, at least we can get well water here in Siltvelt. The inn let us use their water, after all.”
“Then I’ll fetch some later.”
“Thanks. Alright, let’s keep it simple and have a barbecue. Eclair-san, Sakura-chan, keep watch around us, okay?”
Father skillfully started cutting up the meat.

“It would be nice to have some vegetables, but we’ve got plenty of meat, so I guess that’s fine. Since it’s meat from monsters in another world, I don’t know the best way to cook it, and it might have a strong smell.”
“I’ve already removed anything poisonous. Even if it were toxic, last time, Father detoxified and prepared the meat anyway.”
“Just how obsessed with food was I in the last loop? Well… I guess once you understand the system or the world’s mechanics, it makes sense.”
Despite saying that, Father effortlessly trimmed the tendons from the meat. His talent is obvious at a glance.

“Honestly, letting it rest for a while would probably be better. A lot of the blood hasn’t drained properly… Oh, Eclair-san, can you get some string? There were some herbs among the ingredients Motoyasu brought, so I’ll try making some smoked meat.”
“Ah… Sure.”
“Then I shall construct a smoker!”
I carved out some rocks and assembled it. Now that I think about it, in the last loop, Father had me make something similar.
This spear is quite handy for things like this!
“Thanks. Now we just need to hang the meat and smoke it. Motoyasu-kun, can I leave that to you?”
“Leave it to me!”
And so, we waited for Yuki-chan and Kou to return with Ren and Itsuki. If I recall correctly, it was just as Father finished cutting up the meat.
“Gua!”
“Ugh…”

Yuki-chan and Kou returned together. As soon as Ren and Itsuki tumbled off their backs, they collapsed onto the ground. Their armor was in the way, so I helped take it off. Even after I removed their armor, Ren and Itsuki just groaned and didn’t move.
“Ren, Itsuki, welcome back. Dinner’s ready.”
“Ugh…”
Father sounded like a newlywed wife, but Ren and Itsuki just groaned and remained motionless. I poked them lightly with a stick.
“Are you okay?”
“Ugh… I feel awful…”
“I’ve lost count of how many times I passed out… Ugh… At least I hadn’t eaten anything beforehand.”
Groaning, Ren and Itsuki lifted their heads to respond. If they had eaten, they probably would’ve thrown up by now.
“Naofumi… are you okay?”
“What do you mean? Well, the ride was rough, and my butt hurts from all the rubbing, but that’s about it.”
“You got away with just pain!?”
Before finishing his sentence, Itsuki let his head drop to the ground as if he had lost all strength. It almost looked like he was bowing to Father.
“The ride was so bad that I passed out multiple times! Naofumi, wasn’t the Filolial that carried you much better?”
“It did shake a lot, yeah. I wouldn’t say the ride was exactly smooth, though.”
Father answered Ren and Itsuki as if it wasn’t much different.
“…At the very least, tomorrow, can you let me ride the Filolial that Naofumi was on… Sakura-san?”
“Wait, I’m the one who’s riding Sakura!”
For some reason, Ren and Itsuki started arguing over who would ride Sakura-chan next. Well, they were both still collapsed on the ground, only using their voices to argue.
“Ugh… I feel… sick…”
“Let’s continue this conversation after we recover…”
Completely drained, Ren and Itsuki gave up arguing and lay motionless.
“Whoa! We need to take care of them quickly.”
“Then I shall apply some light healing magic. Father, please lay Ren and Itsuki on their backs.”
“Eclair-san, prepare a wet towel!”
“A-Ah!”
After placing the wet towels on Ren and Itsuki’s foreheads, I cast a light healing spell. That should help at least a little.

But still… aren’t Ren and Itsuki kind of weak? The ride on a Filolial should feel like a dream. Eventually, you get so used to it that you can no longer appreciate that dreamlike comfort. I can’t enjoy it anymore myself. It’s a real shame. Father doesn’t seem to understand this feeling at all.
